Maria K.: Heads up — ACME wants a binding surge-cap + soft-floor in their annual commit. They expect ~2.5x burst for up to 30m/day and a guaranteed floor of 50% reserved capacity. Need product wording, launch criteria, and any hard contract constraints we should flag.

Tom H.: We can implement via a priority-lane token + reserved-cap model. Quick back-of-envelope: for a Dedicated P2 pool, 2.5x for 30m/day ~= 37.5 GPU-min/day -> ~1125 GPU-min/month. I'll paste calc.

Tom H.: ```
# surge calc (simplified)
baseline_throughput = 1.0
surge_multiplier = 2.5
surge_minutes_per_day = 30
days_per_month = 30
extra_gpu_minutes_per_month = (surge_multiplier - 1) * surge_minutes_per_day * days_per_month
# = 1.5 * 30 * 30 = 1350 GPU-min/month
```

Leah P.: Launch criteria proposal: (1) Define SLO: p95 latency < 200ms under burst for priority-lane; (2) Cost delta vs baseline < +20% for customer with usual usage; (3) Pilot with 2 customers for 4 weeks; (4) Rollback guardrail: automatic downgrade to baseline model/route if quality regressions observed.

Ashok R.: Operational note — behavior differs by deployment: Dedicated pools can honor a strict floor; Hosted will need routing policy fallback. Contract must specify fallback path and pricing when Dedicated capacity exhausted (e.g., "fallback to hosted at X% higher per-token rate") so we don't silently overcommit. Also call out region constraints (EU vs US) if customer needs regional floor.

Ella (sales): From GTM: customer expects clear billing line items: "reserved floor", "surge allowance", and "overage at burst rate". Can we provide templated clause for legal + sample invoice line? Also need timeline for pilot and SLA credits if floor not met.

Tom H.: ETA: I can produce final numbers + sample = clause in 48 hours. Provisional values to include in draft: reserved floor = 50% of committed vCPUs, surge cap = 2.5x aggregated up to 30m/day, burst enforcement window = rolling 24h.

OpsBot: automated: pricing-engine run complete — estimated incremental monthly cost for requested profile = $12,400 (provisionary). See billing task #4567 for itemized calc: https://tracker.internal/4567

Maria K.: Nice, thanks. I'll draft contract language for Legal and attach the pilot acceptance criteria. @Ella (sales) — can you confirm customer's acceptance window and whether they want explicit rollback penalties or just credits? :white_check_mark:

Ella (sales): I'll check with ACME today and report back by EOD. :+1:

Leah P.: Also flag to Eng: need test harness that can simulate 2.5x burst across 30m to validate latency/cost. I'll open a short spike.

Ashok R.: Agree. Add requirement: metrics instrumentation for per-route capacity usage + early alert if fallback engaged.

Maria K.: Great. Plan: Tom + OpsBot produce numbers/line items, Leah opens spike, I draft legal clause, Ella validates with customer. Recheck in 48h.
